reviews.title: Plugged in and it worked.
reviews.comment: Looked at a lot of specs prior to purchase. This is the one selected over any of the others. Installed in the second slot of the new Dell XPS 8960. It was also cheaper than a second one from Dell.
reviews.author: Paul M
